SUPERSEDES_BASE_RULE.base_superseded_text: PARENT_GOVERNANCE_BLOCKER = YES, or CURRENT_UNRESOLVED_ISSUE_ESTABLISHED = NO (the admissible current evidence disproves the proposed citation defect), or no admissible evidence exists (RUN_COUNT_COMPLETED = 0 or every authorized run incomplete)
SUPERSEDES_BASE_RULE.base_superseded_effect: CURRENT_UNRESOLVED_ISSUE_ESTABLISHED = NO directly establishes C1 / R0
SUPERSEDES_BASE_RULE.defect_impact: a fresh negative or not-established current issue would be forced into R0 / NO_SUPPORTED_ACTION instead of being consumed by the accepted A003 bucket and A005 readiness mechanics

C1_R0_BLOCKER_YES_ONLY_IF_ANY_OF.A: an explicit parent governance blocker blocks all otherwise-permissible action
C1_R0_BLOCKER_YES_ONLY_IF_ANY_OF.B: no admissible workstream / domain-eligible evidence exists
C1_R0_BLOCKER_YES_ONLY_IF_ANY_OF.C: the entire eligible domain disproves the workstream primary family AND the CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES + HISTORICAL_OR_STALE_CASES + RESOLVED_CASES supporting sets are empty

MECHANICAL_EQUIVALENCE_STEPS: STEP_2 else the workstream domain-eligible case set is empty -> C1_R0_BLOCKER = YES

STEP_3 else, when the workstream carries a primary root-cause family filter, every domain-eligible case carries that family in blocked_or_disproven_paths AND the union of CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES + HISTORICAL_OR_STALE_CASES + RESOLVED_CASES is empty -> C1_R0_BLOCKER = YES
FROZEN_RULE.STRUCTURAL_REACHABILITY_NOTE: branch C engages only where a primary root-cause family filter exists; for WS-13 the primary axis is CITATION and the filter is NOT_APPLICABLE, so branch C is structurally not applicable and can never manufacture R0 for WS-13; only A and B can yield C1 for WS-13
FORBIDDEN_DERIVATIONS: RUN_COUNT_COMPLETED = 0 or every authorized run incomplete => R0 (the no-admissible-evidence condition is decided by the workstream domain-eligible evidence set, never by a case-level run-completion counter)
a fresh negative result, a NOT_ESTABLISHED status, a confound or a stale attribution treated as a parent governance blocker
FROZEN_RULE.INTERNAL_HELPER_NOTE: the A / B / C sub-conditions are internal helpers of the C1 derivation only; they are not new A005 readiness gate keys and must never be emitted into the frozen A005 REQUIRED_READINESS_GATE_SCHEMA
FROZEN_RULE.C1_PRECEDENCE: C1 is evaluated before C2 and outranks it; a C1 blocker is assigned before any action-scoped interception is evaluated

UNCHANGED: readiness priority order R4 > R3 > R2 > R1 > R0

SUPERSEDES_BASE_RULE.base_superseded_effect: C2 / R1 hard-wired to the FRESH_ATTRIBUTION-scoped dependency gate regardless of the otherwise-permissible action
SUPERSEDES_BASE_RULE.defect_impact: an actually blocked SEPARATE_EXECUTION or EVIDENCE_RECONCILIATION candidate could be classified R0 instead of R1, and a workstream whose permissible action is EVIDENCE_RECONCILIATION could be deferred by a FRESH_ATTRIBUTION-scoped edge

OTHERWISE_PERMISSIBLE_ACTION_DERIVATION.CANDIDATE_SEMANTICS: the C3 / C4 / C5 candidates are evaluated on their substantive gate conditions only; they do not consume the applicable upstream dependency early and they do not consume the parent governance blocker early (the parent blocker is handled by C1 precedence)

BLOCKED_ACTIONS.construction: BLOCKED_ACTIONS = the set of actions for which an unresolved applicable hard edge exists
BLOCKED_ACTIONS.hard_edge: an unresolved MUST_PRECEDE or BLOCKED_BY edge whose APPLIES_TO_ACTION covers the action (APPLIES_TO_ACTION is the action, or ALL_ACTIONS)
non_blocking: an edge whose APPLIES_TO_ACTION does not cover the action
BLOCKED_ACTIONS.unresolved: an upstream workstream is unresolved while it still carries a CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES or HISTORICAL_OR_STALE_CASES set (accepted unresolved_upstream_dependencies semantics)
BLOCKED_ACTIONS.graph_source: the accepted action-scoped graph is consumed read-only; this amendment does not edit the graph

INTERCEPTION_RULE: if OTHERWISE_PERMISSIBLE_ACTION in BLOCKED_ACTIONS: R1 / C2 / DEFER_PENDING_UPSTREAM
else NONE: R0 / C6 otherwise-R0 fallback
FROZEN_RULE.PARENT_GOVERNANCE_BLOCKER_ROLE: handled by C1 precedence only; never re-consumed inside the C2 / C3 / C4 / C5 evaluations
FROZEN_RULE.CURRENT_GRAPH_CONSEQUENCE: the WS-11 MUST_PRECEDE edge blocks only SEPARATE_EXECUTION and can never defer WS-13 FRESH_ATTRIBUTION; WS-12 CAN_PRECEDE is non-blocking

SUPERSEDES_BASE_RULE.base_superseded_text: CLASSIFICATION_SEMANTIC_KEY_SET = OBSERVATION_SEMANTIC_KEY_SET (RULE = EQUALS_OBSERVATION_SEMANTIC_KEY_SET; value = identical to OBSERVATION_SEMANTIC_KEY_SET)
SUPERSEDES_BASE_RULE.base_superseded_effect: the classification digest was an exact copy of the observation digest over the same key set, so classifier outputs (predicate outputs, per-run status, confounds) and the classifier identity were bound by no digest
SUPERSEDES_BASE_RULE.defect_impact: a changed predicate table, truth-table application, confound derivation or classifier implementation could not change any classification digest

PAYLOAD_SEMANTICS.observation_semantic_digest: the per-run digest computed over exactly the frozen observation semantic key set of that run; the observation layer is bound only through this single digest and is never re-hashed field-by-field here
PAYLOAD_SEMANTICS.run_ordinal: the authorized run position of the same run
PAYLOAD_SEMANTICS.predicate_outputs: the 12 frozen predicate outputs of that run (exactly the frozen classification_predicates.predicate_evaluation_order names)
PAYLOAD_SEMANTICS.per_run_citation_status: the run citation-status value produced by the frozen truth table
PAYLOAD_SEMANTICS.effective_ws13_design_digest: the effective design identity under which the run was classified
PAYLOAD_SEMANTICS.classifier_sha256: the future classifier implementation identity (a REQUIRED_EXTERNAL_BINDING_BEFORE_G4 role; never invented here)

FROZEN_RULE.CANONICAL_DIGEST_RULE: canonical JSON: json.dumps(sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=comma-colon), UTF-8 encoded, SHA256
FROZEN_RULE.BINDING_REQUIREMENT: any change to a predicate output, the per-run citation status, a confound value, the classifier identity, the effective design identity or the observation semantic digest must change the classification semantic digest

fix_3_classification_semantic_digest_bin.G5_SCHEMA_NOTE: g5_attribution_schema.value_domains.CLASSIFICATION_SEMANTIC_DIGESTS keeps its name and its per-run role; only the key set and payload it is computed over are superseded by this fix

SUPERSEDES_BASE_RULE.base_superseded_text: a single ambiguous observation field retrieval.sent_evidence_text_or_governed_content_hash accepted either the exact sent-evidence text or its governed canonical content hash
SUPERSEDES_BASE_RULE.base_superseded_effect: the support predicate and the retrieval-confound rule could be satisfied by a hash-only record, and the sent evidence was not represented canonically
SUPERSEDES_BASE_RULE.defect_impact: non-deterministic support matching and a non-canonical sent-evidence representation in the future G4 observation record

FROZEN_RULE.sent_context_id: canonical sent material / context identity of the sent context
FROZEN_RULE.sent_evidence_text: the exact application-level text actually sent
FROZEN_RULE.sent_evidence_content_sha256: SHA256 hex digest of the UTF-8 encoding of the exact sent_evidence_text; not the canonical-lf file-hash contract
FROZEN_RULE.HASH_PRECONDITION: no Unicode normalization, no newline normalization, no trim, no rewrite and no reconstruction is performed before hashing
MISSING_FIELD_BEHAVIOR: hash mismatch between the recomputed SHA256 of sent_evidence_text and sent_evidence_content_sha256 => invalid observation / NOT_ESTABLISHED
FROZEN_RULE.SUPPORT_PREDICATE_INPUTS: SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE_PRESENT uses ONLY the exact sent_evidence_text records plus the frozen expected facts under the frozen exact-substring match; sent_evidence_content_sha256 is integrity only and is never matching material
FROZEN_RULE.RETRIEVAL_CONFOUND_RULE_INPUTS: the admissible inputs become the sent_evidence_records text (exact) plus the frozen expected contract; the prohibited inputs (DB-only content, retrieved-but-unsent chunks, historical evidence, manual evidence) are unchanged

STEP_5 derive CURRENT_ATTRIBUTION_STATUS by accepted A005 _current_attribution_status() semantics
STEP_6 derive the C5 fresh-attribution candidate

FRESH_POSITIVE_PROJECTION.WHY_MECHANICALLY_ESTABLISHED: the accepted A005 gate_issue over CURRENT_CONFIRMED cases is YES only when the relevant primary-axis confidence set is exactly MECHANICALLY_ESTABLISHED, so a determinate mechanically-established fresh positive must be translated to MECHANICALLY_ESTABLISHED and never copied verbatim as DETERMINATE_ALL_RUNS_AGREE

FRESH_NEGATIVE_PROJECTION.THEN: the accepted A003 Citation mechanics project CURRENT_NEGATIVE_CASES with the accepted current-negative reason semantics CURRENT_NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE

synthesizing CURRENTLY_ESTABLISHED attribution status from a fresh negative

BRANCH_RULE: PRESERVE_INHERITED_HISTORICAL_OR_STALE_RECORD: an admissible inherited historical / stale A003 record exists for the case under the accepted mechanics; its inherited accepted citation_confidence (e.g. HISTORICAL_ONLY) is preserved mechanically and is never overwritten merely because the fresh observation is NOT_ESTABLISHED

NEW_PROJECTED_NOT_ESTABLISHED_RECORD: no admissible inherited historical / stale record exists and the minimum projected record fields are materializable; the projection emits citation_status = NOT_ESTABLISHED and citation_confidence = NOT_ESTABLISHED with the relevant supporting / limiting / source trace
NOT_ESTABLISHED_AND_FAIL_CLOSED_PROJECTI.IF_ANY_REQUIRED_FIELD_UNDEFINED: no admissible current projection / fail closed

OTHER_STATUSES.RESOLVED_OR_CLOSED: consume only already accepted A003 status / confidence / bucket semantics; existing closure prerequisites are required; no new mapping is created
OTHER_STATUSES.STALE_ATTRIBUTION_REQUIRES_REFRESH: consume only already accepted A003 status / confidence / bucket semantics; no new mapping is created

MINIMUM_PROJECTED_RECORD.UNDEFINED_REQUIRED_FIELD_EFFECT: no admissible current projection / fail closed

CURRENT_UNRESOLVED_ISSUE_ESTABLISHED_DER: if PROJECTED_CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES is non-empty: the confidence set is the set of projected citation_confidence values and the value is YES iff that set is exactly MECHANICALLY_ESTABLISHED, else NOT_ESTABLISHED
BUCKET_AND_A005_CONSUMPTION.HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_MATERIAL_DERIVATION: YES iff the projected HISTORICAL_OR_STALE_CASES set is non-empty (accepted A005 historical_material mechanics)
BUCKET_AND_A005_CONSUMPTION.FRESH_NEGATIVE_EXCLUSIVITY: a fresh negative projects cit-001 into CURRENT_NEGATIVE_CASES; the projected case state carries exactly one bucket per eligible case, so the superseded stale membership of cit-001 cannot simultaneously establish HISTORICAL_OR_STALE material
CURRENT_ATTRIBUTION_STATUS_DERIVATION: for WS-13 (CITATION axis, primary root-cause filter NOT_APPLICABLE) this reduces to: if CURRENT_UNRESOLVED_ISSUE_ESTABLISHED != YES then CURRENT_ATTRIBUTION_STATUS = NOT_CURRENTLY_ESTABLISHED, else CURRENTLY_ESTABLISHED
BUCKET_AND_A005_CONSUMPTION.VALID_FRESH_NEGATIVE_OUTCOME: a fresh negative may validly yield CURRENT_UNRESOLVED_ISSUE_ESTABLISHED = NO together with CURRENT_ATTRIBUTION_STATUS = NOT_CURRENTLY_ESTABLISHED; loop prevention comes from the projected bucket / material state, never from custom attribution semantics
BUCKET_AND_A005_CONSUMPTION.C5_SUBSTANTIVE_CANDIDATE_RULE: C5_FRESH_ATTRIBUTION_CANDIDATE = YES iff HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_MATERIAL = YES AND CURRENT_ATTRIBUTION_STATUS = NOT_CURRENTLY_ESTABLISHED AND FRESH_ATTRIBUTION_TARGET_SET_DEFINABLE = YES AND MATERIAL_SOURCE_CONFLICT = NO AND PRODUCT_MEASUREMENT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED = NO
BUCKET_AND_A005_CONSUMPTION.FRESH_DEPENDENCY_HANDLING: intercepted by the FIX 2 action-scoped C2

REQUIRED_FUTURE_G3_TESTS: T01 positive determinate / mechanically-established / FRESH / compatible / 3-of-3 -> confidence MECHANICALLY_ESTABLISHED -> CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES
T02 negative determinate / FRESH / compatible / 3-of-3 -> confidence SUPPORTED -> CURRENT_NEGATIVE_CASES
T03 positive CURRENT_CONFIRMED with confidence MECHANICALLY_ESTABLISHED -> A005 CURRENT_UNRESOLVED_ISSUE_ESTABLISHED = YES
T04 CURRENT_NEGATIVE excludes simultaneous HISTORICAL_OR_STALE membership
T05 fresh negative does not synthesize CURRENTLY_ESTABLISHED attribution
T06 gate_issue != YES -> accepted attribution status NOT_CURRENTLY_ESTABLISHED
T07 NOT_ESTABLISHED and NOT_ESTABLISHED_DUE_TO_* never project CURRENT_CONFIRMED / CURRENT_NEGATIVE
T08 a new projected NOT_ESTABLISHED record -> confidence NOT_ESTABLISHED
T09 a preserved inherited historical / stale record -> the inherited accepted confidence is preserved (e.g. HISTORICAL_ONLY)
T10 admissible positive / negative current projections explicitly store latest_product_state_compatible = YES
